stem.text: A uranium-238 nucleus, ${}^{238}_{92}\text{U}$, undergoes a series of nuclear decays to form uranium-234, ${}^{234}_{92}\text{U}$.
Which series of decays could give this result?

C.text: emission of one $\alpha$-particle and two $\beta^{-}$ particles

D.text: emission of two $\alpha$-particles and eight $\beta^{-}$ particles
